// FROZEN ORACLE — the Quote Builder's computePrice() exactly as committed at 4fe62aa (quote-builder-v2.html L3611-3666),
// before it was changed to delegate to js/pricing-core.js. VERBATIM; do not edit. tests/pricing-core.test.mjs evaluates this
// text in a vm context (dimsMm / runsVal / DB / document supplied) and compares pricing-core against it.
function computePrice(p){
  if(!p) return 0;
  let price = p.basePrice||0;
  const consts = DB.constants||{};
  const matMult = consts.materialPriceIndexMultiplier||1.0;
  calcPriceWarning='';

  if(p.formulaType==='per_length' && p.formula){
    const dd = p.defaultDimensions||{};
    const W = dimsMm.W ?? dd.W ?? 900;
    const base = p.formula.baseLengthMm||900;
    const ppm = p.formula.pricePerExtraMm||0;
    const extra = Math.max(0, W-base);
    price = p.basePrice + extra*ppm;

    // Width (D) / Height (H) surcharge — only when the user actually moved
    // the dimension above the product's own default (mirrors the Length
    // Math.max(0, W-base) behavior: shrinking below default never discounts).
    const missingRates=[];
    [['D','Width'],['H','Height']].forEach(([dim,label])=>{
      if(!(dim in dimsMm)) return;              // no such input for this product
      const val=dimsMm[dim], defVal=dd[dim];
      if(defVal==null || val<=defVal) return;   // unchanged or shrunk — no surcharge
      const rate=p.formula['rate'+dim+'100'];
      if(rate==null){ missingRates.push(label); return; }
      price += ((val-defVal)/100)*rate;
    });
    if(missingRates.length){
      calcPriceWarning=`No rate on file for custom ${missingRates.join(' / ')} — priced at default size for ${missingRates.join('/')}.`;
    }
  } else if(p.formulaType==='per_area' && p.formula){
    const W = dimsMm.W ?? p.defaultDimensions.W ?? 1000;
    const H = dimsMm.H ?? p.defaultDimensions.H ?? 1000;
    const sqm = (W*H)/1e6;
    price = sqm * (p.formula.pricePerSqm||0);
  } else if(p.formulaType==='per_run' && p.formula){
    const runs = runsVal||1;
    price = (p.formula.pricePerRun||p.basePrice) * runs;
  }

  price *= matMult;

  // Add spec price adders
  if(p.specs&&p.specs.length){
    p.specs.forEach((s,i)=>{
      const sel=document.getElementById(`spec_${i}`);
      if(sel){
        const oi=parseInt(sel.value||0);
        const adder=s.priceAdder&&s.priceAdder[oi]?s.priceAdder[oi]:0;
        price+=adder;
      }
    });
  }

  return Math.max(0,Math.round(price));
}
